objective: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.

description: You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, <class>.  And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid.  But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span.  It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.
Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade.  I want him dead, <name>.  For Longbraid!  Bring me his head!
progress: I won't let foolish Human bureaucracy interfere with Dwarven matters, <name>. Kam Deepfury is a proven conspirator in the Thandol Span attack. King Magni's good people lost their lives because of Deepfury's deceit. The Humans might be content to let Deepfury rot in The Stockade but I will not sleep soundly at night until Deepfury is slain.
completion: So Kam Deepfury finally got to feel what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death? Good. Serves the cowardly Dark Iron scum right. You have done well, <class>. The victims of the Thandol Span attack were but mere victims in a world torn with war and unrest. Their families will have the peace of knowing Deepfury got the punishment he deserved. Longbraid's brother's death has been avenged.
